problem: The status lookup for one existing completed batch reports an indeterminate result after that batch contains a failed record, so the batch operator cannot distinguish failed completion from successful completion.
outcome: For one requested existing completed batch, lookup has exactly one effect: it identifies that batch and reports successful completion when every record succeeded or failed completion when any record failed.
acceptance: The lookup identifies only the requested existing completed batch and reports whether it completed successfully or contained any failed record
Invoking the lookup emits no other output, event, notification, state change, or action
Missing, incomplete, and multiple-batch requests are outside this operation
